author: jojobloblo
body: I don't know if this is supposed to happen (if it is that's just stupid no offense but it really is) but in the spawns for the map Illegal Office... ok say I'm on blue. I spawn and a red guy comes into our spawn. Well on most maps you can't, so that's one thing. But when he does go in nobody can hit him. So he can easily spawn kill. I just thought I'd point this out I found out because I went in and killed about 5 people and didn't realize that I wasn't getting hit because of that. I thought it was because of my swiftness two potion and nobody could hit me... I didn't consider it spawn killing because I figured I'd die immediately... so yeah that really needs to be fixed.

replies.author: Classical_freaK
replies.body: I don't feel that he deserves an infraction for that; he clearly is fessing up to it, so it's not like he was deliberately breaking rules. He came and posted a thread, well aware that what he was saying was admittance to a broken rule. On top of that he's only trying to improve gameplay and fairness in the Nebula maps. I was personally online when he did that, well I guess it's considered 'spawn-killing', although I'd call it a fault on behalf of the map-maker, and he repeatedly apologized for what he did.
